Gen-Eat

Order from your campus cafe over WhatsApp and collect it when it is ready, instead of queueing between lectures.

What the product publishes

In its own words

Read directly from the product’s own public surface on 16 Sep 2026. Nothing in this section is inferred.

What it is“USIU campus food, on tap.” The home page opens: “Eat between classes.”
Published structureCafés · Campus map · For owners · About · Order now.
How ordering runsOrdering happens over WhatsApp with no app to install, and payment runs on M-Pesa through the platform’s own payment rail.

Evidence strengthPublished. Described by the product, not measured by us. EV-REACH-01 · capture 16 Sep 2026.

What we read into it
Source fact
The product publishes its cafés, campus map, owner surface and ordering route.
Interpretation
That this evidences payments and reconciliation and coordination and fulfilment is our reading of that published structure.
Limit
No order volume, no café count and no revenue is published. The pilot is at one university.
Maturity
Public stateLive. Deployed and reachable on its own domain.
Evidence strengthPublished, from the product’s own surface.
DeploymentA pilot at USIU.
Record depthFull.
Related workBizMtaani, the same coordination responsibility on a neighbourhood instead of a campus.

Not claimedNo orders, no transactions, no revenue, no café count and no student numbers. Live is how far the system has got, not how much it carries.

Related work

BizMtaani carries the same coordination and payment responsibility across a neighbourhood. Gen-Eat runs it inside one campus, where the walk between counter and lecture is the whole problem.
